title: HARNESS DEFAULT — a fresh character on the harbour steps at Lilmoth, in the Western Rootlands. NOT where the game starts.
note: W1-01. The province is real: 4,825 x 5,540 m, 14.24 km2 of walkable land placed from RI-WLD01 §3 verbatim. Lilmoth is the tier-1 start (RI-WLD04 §difficulty tiers). The old 420 m origin neighbourhood survives as the state `showcase_patch` and as the anchor for the twelve canonical viewpoints.
not_the_player_start: A player who clicks New at the title screen NEVER passes through this state. Engine._titleApply('new') calls censusBegin({}), which stages 'barge-hold' and then 'writ-house' — both tagged "settlement": "thorn". This file is what main.js loads when no ?state= is given, which is every harness tool in tools/, and that is the correct thing for a tool measuring THE WORLD to do. It is not a measurement of the opening. Evidence: reports/spawn-truth/2026-08-14-spawn-truth.md. Measuring the opening: tools/lib/opening.mjs startOpening(), or node tools/harness/first-ten.mjs (which now defaults to --start shipping).
